semantics.identity_rule: Objective, metric/evidence, SLO evaluation, source resource and Event identities remain distinct.
semantics.derived_rule: Healthy/degraded/breached status is visibly derived evidence, not semantic ownership or authorization.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing/acknowledging service health grants no data or remediation authority.
semantics.graph_rule: Objective→evidence→SLO→Event edges correspond only to explicit refs.
semantics.failure_rule: Unknown, partial, stale, degraded and breached states remain visibly distinct.

invariants.rule: Freshness, availability, completeness, latency and SLO results are derived service-health evidence over exact data/runtime scopes; they never change data identity, ownership, classification, authorization or execution authority.

hard_gates.condition: SLO evaluation conflated with dataset identity
visual graph invents causal breach relation
